name: BioStation A2
tagLine: Android-based fingerprint and card time & attendance terminal.
summary:
The BioStation A2 is an intelligent Android-based time and attendance terminal combining fingerprint recognition, RFID card reading and a bright 5-inch touchscreen into one compact unit. Its open Android platform makes it easy to deploy custom T&A applications, while native integration with leading payroll systems — including SAGE, PaySpace and Time & Attendance platforms common in the South African market — reduces implementation time significantly.

With a capacitive touchscreen, on-device web server and support for both wired Ethernet and Wi-Fi, the BioStation A2 suits everything from single-site SMEs to multi-branch retail and manufacturing operations.

features.title: Android open platform
features.description: Deploy your T&A software directly on the device, or use the built-in BioStar 2 T&A module.

features.title: 5-inch touchscreen
features.description: Large, responsive display with on-screen shift status, messages and employee self-service options.

features.title: SA payroll integration
features.description: Compatible with SAGE, PaySpace, VIP Payroll and other platforms widely used in South Africa.

features.title: 100 000 fingerprint capacity
features.description: Handles large workforces without sacrificing authentication speed — average match time under 1 second.

items.Card types: 125 kHz EM / 13.56 MHz Mifare, DESFire / NFC
